notes: v3.0.81 - Supervised Athena draft placement is hardened: HPI, ROS, Physical Exam, Assessment, Plan, full encounter notes, and Procedure Documentation match only reviewed exact destinations; look-alike labels and duplicate or nonempty targets fail closed.
